charts.name: Levitation
charts.note: Counted weight of one 20 kg carried item, after Mastery. The item is not exempted. Lower is better; this does not change equipped weight.

charts.name: Equipping
charts.note: Calculated equip cost of one Mythical (A), level 1,000 item. Minimum 1 Essence. Charging is intentionally deferred; this is the modelled price.

charts.name: Overlevel
charts.note: Level Fit for a level 10 character wearing a level 100 item. Higher is better; 100% means full item effect. Weight is not scaled by Level Fit.

charts.name: Capacity
charts.note: Total inventory weight capacity, including Mastery. The vertical axis is logarithmic. Capacity does not imply that overload enforcement is active.

charts.name: Exemption
charts.note: Number of heaviest carried items excluded from inventory weight. Exemption grows in whole slots at Mastery thresholds.

charts.name: Priority
charts.note: Modelled queue-time advantage. Priority is not connected to the current moderation queue; this curve does not describe an active reduction in waiting time.

charts.name: Flow
charts.note: Mining Points bonus while Flow is active. A 5% bonus means a 1.05 multiplier; the chart does not assume Flow is always active.

charts.name: Focus
charts.note: Time window for keeping Flow active. Includes the starter window and Mastery. The final window cannot exceed 720 minutes.

charts.name: Power
charts.note: Mining reward bonus, including Mastery. Zero bonus means a 1.00 multiplier. The direct grant scales the bonus rather than adding percentage points.

charts.name: Loot
charts.note: Expected Chest Shard rolls per eligible completion. For example, 1.25 means one guaranteed roll and a 25% chance of another roll.

charts.name: Scrapping
charts.note: Essence returned from a Rare (D) item with 1,000 invested Essence. Includes rarity base, recovered investment and Mastery; excludes Lucky Scrapping.

charts.name: Leveling
charts.note: Share of the base level-up price remaining after the trait and Mastery. Lower is better. Actual payment is rounded up and cannot fall below 1 Essence.

charts.name: Merging
charts.note: Share of the base merge price remaining, including Mastery. Lower is better; the curve retains a 25% soft core. Actual payment is rounded up.

charts.name: Rarity
charts.note: Share of the base rarity-evolution price remaining, including Mastery. Lower is better; the curve retains a 20% soft core. Actual payment is rounded up.

charts.name: Quality
charts.note: Minimum share of the remaining quality gap closed by an improvement. This is a roll floor, not the average result or the absolute final quality.

charts.name: Fee
charts.note: Seller commission before Lucky Discount. Lower is better; the curve retains a 3% soft core. The final Gold fee is rounded down.

charts.name: Bid
charts.note: Effective sorting price as a share of the actual Gold bid. Lower is better; settlement still uses the actual bid. Auction surface is planned.

charts.name: Liquidity
charts.note: Effective LP requirement as a share of the base requirement. Lower is better. The Gem Points surface is planned; this does not increase direct QFT rewards.

charts.name: Conversion
charts.note: Silver received per Gold burned. Mastery and flat grants are added after the pressure curve, so 30 is not a final cap. Actual Silver payout is rounded down.

charts.name: Slots
charts.note: Maximum active marketplace listings. Percent grants scale only the trait base; Mastery and flat grants are added separately.

charts.name: Efficiency
charts.note: Base cost of an action that normally costs 100 Stamina, before equipped-weight pressure. Lower is better. The backend applies its usual rounding.

charts.name: Absorption
charts.note: Additional recovery from a Stamina Potion, up to +250%. Potion integration is planned; this plots the RPG formula.

charts.name: Reserve
charts.note: Maximum Stamina, including starter reserve and Mastery. The vertical axis is logarithmic. This is capacity, not the current Stamina balance.

charts.name: Recovery
charts.note: Stamina recovered per minute, including Mastery. The vertical axis is logarithmic. This is a rate, not time to refill a separate Reserve build.

charts.name: Relief
charts.note: Extra action-cost pressure from 10 kg of equipped items. Lower is better; 25% pressure means a 1.25 multiplier on base action cost. Carried inventory is excluded.

charts.name: Shards
charts.note: Weight of each missing shard relative to each owned shard. The vertical axis is logarithmic. This is not a drop probability; probability also depends on the shard pool.

charts.name: Boxes
charts.note: Chance to receive one extra higher-rarity lootbox from a Common Lootbox opening, including Mastery. This is not an upgrade to the opened box. The final chance is capped at 30%.

charts.name: Chance
charts.note: Chance of a Lucky proc. Mastery and grants scale chance weight, not percentage points; the result approaches 50%.

charts.name: Bonus
charts.note: Effects conditional on a Lucky proc, not expected value per action. Reward power and discount rate are separate outputs. Lucky Scrapping applies reward power only to unrecovered investment.

charts.name: Cards
charts.note: Expected turns in a Common Lootbox, including its starter turn. A value of 4.73 means four guaranteed turns and a 73% chance of one more turn.
